enchantment.epicadditions.soul_tied.desc: Ties items to your soul, preventing them from being taken by death.
When applied to boots, prevents wearer vibrations of stepping, falling, throwing, and equipping.
hovertext.epicadditions.item.pocket_cell: Debug Item for testing pocket cell generation. Dev Purposes, cells will not be assigned to any player.
Unlinks your own pocket cell from your uuid. Used for dev debug purposes. Will result in a new Pocket Cell being generated.
You have Pocket Cell #%d on this server.
hovertext.epicadditions.item.pocket_key: Used to travel to the Pocket Dimension
hovertext.epicadditions.item.upgrade_lev: Pocket Cell Level has been upgraded to level %d!
hovertext.epicadditions.item.dimensional: Eat to increase Pocket Cell level. Each level increases height of cell by one block.
hovertext.epicadditions.item.not_yet_fun: This item is not yet functional. It is currently in-development.
advancements.epicadditions.progression.p: Obtain a key to your very own cell in the Pocket Dimension.
